description_en: Adds a secondary CIDR block to a VPC
kebab_example: aliyun vpc associate-vpc-cidr-block --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-o6wrloqsdqc9io3mg0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateVpcCidrBlock

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC to which you want to add a secondary CIDR block. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
需要添加附加网段的VPC所在地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC to which you want to add a secondary CIDR block
parameters.help_zh: 需要添加附加网段的VPC的ID。
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The secondary IPv4 CIDR block to add. The CIDR block must meet the following requirements:

Use private IPv4 addresses specified in RFC 1918 as the secondary IPv4 CIDR block of the virtual private cloud (VPC). The subnet mask must be 16 to 28 bits in length. Examples: 10.0.0.0/16, 172.16.0.0/16, and 192.168.0.0/16.
You can use a custom CIDR block other than 100.64.0.0/10, 224.0.0.0/4, 127.0.0.0/8, or 169.254.0.0/16 and their subnets as the secondary IPv4 CIDR block of the virtual private cloud (VPC).

Configuration limits:
The CIDR block cannot start with 0. The subnet mask must be 16 to 28 bits in length.

The secondary CIDR block cannot overlap with the primary CIDR block or existing secondary CIDR blocks of the VPC.

If you do not use an IPAM pool to add a secondary CIDR block to the VPC, you must specify either the SecondaryCidrBlock parameter or the Ipv6CidrBlock parameter, but not both
parameters.help_zh:
需要添加的附加IPv4网段，网段要求如下：

建议您使用RFC 1918标准中指定的私有IPv4地址作为VPC的附加IPv4网段，网段掩码推荐使用16~28位。例如：10.0.0.0/16、172.16.0.0/16、192.168.0.0/16。
使用除100.64.0.0/10、224.0.0.0/4、127.0.0.0/8、169.254.0.0/16及其子网外的自定义地址段作为专有网络的附加IPv4网段。

配置限制如下：
不能以0开头，网段掩码推荐使用16~28位。

附加网段不得与VPC主网段及已添加的附加网段重叠。

不通过IPAM地址池为VPC添加附加网段时，参数SecondaryCidrBlock和参数Ipv6CidrBlock必须输入一个且不能都输入
parameters.name: secondary_cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The subnet mask used to add a secondary IPv4 CIDR block from an IPAM pool to the VPC.

When you use an IPAM pool to add a secondary IPv4 CIDR block to the VPC, you must specify at least one of SecondaryCidrBlock or SecondaryCidrMask
parameters.help_zh:
通过输入掩码的方式从IPAM地址池为VPC添加附加IPv4网段。

指定IPAM地址池为VPC添加附加IPv4网段时，参数SecondaryCidrBlock或SecondaryCidrMask至少输入一个
parameters.name: secondary_cidr_mask

parameters.help_en:
The specified IPv6 CIDR block of the VPC.

You cannot specify both SecondaryCidrBlock and Ipv6CidrBlock
parameters.help_zh:
VPC的指定IPv6网段。

参数SecondaryCidrBlock和参数Ipv6CidrBlock不能都输入
parameters.name: ipv6_cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The type of the IPv6 CIDR block of the VPC. Valid values:

BGP (default): Alibaba Cloud BGP IPv6.
ChinaMobile: China Mobile (single ISP).
ChinaUnicom: China Unicom (single ISP).
ChinaTelecom: China Telecom (single ISP).

If your account is included in the China single-ISP bandwidth whitelist, you can set this parameter to ChinaTelecom (China Telecom), ChinaUnicom (China Unicom), or ChinaMobile (China Mobile)
parameters.help_zh:
VPC的IPv6地址段类型，取值：

BGP（默认值）：阿里云BGP IPv6。
ChinaMobile：中国移动（单线）。
ChinaUnicom：中国联通（单线）。
ChinaTelecom：中国电信（单线）。

如果是开通了单线带宽白名单的用户，该字段可以设置为ChinaTelecom（中国电信）、ChinaUnicom（中国联通）和ChinaMobile（中国移动）
parameters.name: ipv6_isp

parameters.help_en:
The version of the IP address. Valid values:

IPV4: IPv4 address.
IPV6: IPv6 address. When IpVersion is set to IPV6 and SecondaryCidrBlock is not specified, a secondary IPv6 CIDR block is added to the VPC
parameters.help_zh:
IP地址的版本类型。取值：

IPV4：IPv4地址。
IPV6：IPv6地址，当IpVersion参数输入IPV6，SecondaryCidrBlock参数不传值时可以为VPC添加附加IPv6网段
parameters.name: ip_version

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the IPAM pool
parameters.name: ipam_pool_id

parameters.help_en:
The subnet mask used to add an IPv6 CIDR block from an IPAM pool to the VPC.

When you use an IPAM pool to add a secondary IPv6 CIDR block to the VPC, you must specify at least one of IPv6CidrBlock or Ipv6CidrMask
parameters.help_zh:
通过输入掩码的方式从IPAM地址池为VPC添加IPv6网段。

指定IPAM地址池为VPC添加附加IPv6网段时，参数IPv6CidrBlock或Ipv6CidrMask至少输入一个
parameters.name: ipv6_cidr_mask

CidrBlock.description_en: The secondary CIDR block added to the VPC

IpVersion.description_en: The IP address version of the secondary CIDR block
